ar.title: الديك الرومي

steps.n1: يفرم البصل مع الثوم وورق اللورا، ثم يتبل بالتوابل ويعصر عليه ليمون كثير.
steps.n2: يتبل الديك من الداخل والخارج جيدا ويدخل الثلاجة يوما كاملا.
steps.n3: نحضر صينية مدهونة زيت ويوضع فيها الديك المتبل ويغطى بالفويل.
steps.n4: ويدخل الفرن لمدة ساعتين تقريبا مع ملاحظة تقليبه على الوجه الآخر.
steps.n5: بعد النضج يمكن تقطيعه شرائح ويرص في طبق التقديم.

en.title: Roasted Turkey

steps.n1: Finely mince the onion with the garlic and bay leaves, then season with the spices and add plenty of lemon juice.
steps.n2: Season the turkey thoroughly inside and out, then refrigerate for one full day.
steps.n3: Prepare a baking tray greased with oil, place the marinated turkey inside, and cover it with foil.
steps.n4: Place in the oven for approximately 2 hours, making sure to flip it onto the other side halfway through.
steps.n5: Once cooked, slice the turkey and arrange the pieces on a serving platter.

legacySteps: Finely mince the onion with the garlic and bay leaves, then season with the spices and add plenty of lemon juice.

Place in the oven for approximately 2 hours, making sure to flip it onto the other side halfway through.
Once cooked, slice the turkey and arrange the pieces on a serving platter.
